1: An eighteen-year-old boy who has spent his life drifting alongside his con-artist father makes dozens of armed agents freeze in their tracks the moment his eyes begin to glow.
2: He possesses the ability to project illusions into other people's minds, a power coveted by two rival secret organizations.
3: Yet the real shock lies elsewhere, as everything he has ever believed turns out to be a lie.
4: In Spain's Ebro Delta, Vicente and his son Ian are a pair of drifters scraping by day to day on petty scams.
5: While his father settles the bill with a shopkeeper, Ian stares intently into the store from outside.
6: Using his power to plant illusions in people's minds, Ian makes a few small coins look like a large sum of money.
7: However, the shopkeeper soon realizes he has been tricked and charges out brandishing a hammer.
8: Cornered, Ian conjures the illusion of firing a gun to scare him off.
9: As the father and son speed away in their truck, Vicente angrily scolds his son.
10: Vicente lives by two ironclad rules, the first of which is to never draw attention to themselves.
11: Ian, however, feels differently, complaining that they only ever go after pocket change and suggesting they rob a bank instead.
12: Just then, a police car pulls up right behind them in hot pursuit.
13: Ian glares at the cruiser through the rear window, and the officers, fooled by his illusion, flip their car right in front of a gas station.
14: Soon after, men dressed in black arrive at the scene of the crash.
15: Watching the father and son through a tablet screen is a woman named Adriana.
16: The next day is Ian's eighteenth birthday, and the pair celebrate aboard the old boat they call home with candles stuck into a frying pan.
17: Having stayed up all night thinking things through, Vicente shares his plan to get a job as a mechanic so Ian can focus on studying biology.
18: Having already lost his wife, Vicente is determined not to lose his son as well.
19: He then pulls out a worn photograph taken on the day he first discovered Ian's ability.
20: It was the day a young Ian, tired of begging for a balloon, simply conjured one out of thin air himself.
21: Tired of living on a boat under his father's strict rules for years, Ian persuades his dad to let him visit an arcade just once.
22: While Ian dreams of an ordinary life, mysterious figures are already investigating yesterday's crash.
23: Among them is an enigmatic man in sunglasses known as the Perceptor.
24: That night, armed agents storm Vicente's boat.
25: The raid is led by Adriana, whom Vicente seems to recognize.
26: As agents swarm toward the arcade, Vicente rushes to find his son.
27: At that very moment, the Perceptor appears and begins taking down the agents one by one.
28: Wearing a VR helmet, the Perceptor defeats the armed operatives with his bare hands before slowly taking the helmet off.
29: While the Perceptor battles the agents, Ian is ultimately captured by the Agency.
30: When he opens his eyes, he finds himself inside a secret laboratory.
31: Adriana explains that the world is in the middle of a secret war against Awareness, an organization of people who share Ian's abilities.
32: She claims that Awareness has long been secretly manipulating the minds of world leaders, politicians, and militaries, and that the Agency exists to stop them.
33: She adds that the man from the arcade, the Perceptor, is the last survivor of Awareness and the most powerful individual they have ever encountered.
34: Adriana is also after one more thing: the formula said to flow in Ian's blood, a substance capable of either creating or erasing their powers.
35: Adriana decides to put Ian's abilities to the test.
36: Explaining that stronger emotions produce stronger projections, Adriana begins probing Ian's deepest wounds one by one.
37: Provoked to anger, Ian traps Adriana in an illusion of a beach and even plants an endlessly buzzing fly inside her mind.
38: Granted permission to see his father in return, Ian finally reunites with Vicente and tightly embraces him as he lies in bed.
39: Noticing that Adriana and Vicente already know each other, a suspicious Ian is urged by Adriana to look directly into his father's memories himself.
40: Vicente frantically begs him not to listen to her, terrified that the past he has hidden for so long is about to be exposed.
41: For the first time, Ian steps into his father's memories.
42: There, he sees this very laboratory years ago, with a young Vicente fleeing with a crying baby in his arms.
43: Meanwhile, tests on Ian's body reveal no trace of the chemical formula that supposedly creates their powers.
44: Adriana's superior responds coldly, declaring that without the formula, the boy is nothing more than a liability.
45: Adriana objects, arguing that Ian is the only one who can stand against the Mule, the most powerful Perceptor of all, when he eventually surfaces.
46: When the order is finally given to eliminate Ian, a girl locked in the adjacent cell wakes him up.
47: Meanwhile, researchers re-examining Ian's test results discover that his readings are skyrocketing far beyond anything they anticipated.
48: The girl, whose name is Esther, effortlessly takes down the guards in an instant and clears a path for them to escape.
49: Moments later, Adriana arrives to find Ian's cell completely empty.
50: Taking advantage of the blaring alarms, Ian and Esther rescue his father as well, and the three of them flee toward the rooftop.
51: Racing down a forest road under a hail of bullets, they finally manage to shake off their pursuers.
52: Back at the laboratory, nothing remains behind except unconscious guards scattered across the floor.
53: The car carrying the three fugitives disappears deep along the forest road.
54: Yet someone else is watching them from the woods—the Perceptor himself.
55: Once they reach their hideout, Ian questions Esther about everything that has happened.
56: Sitting side by side on the rooftop, Esther offers Ian a perspective completely different from anything he has heard during his lifetime in hiding.
57: Then, the two of them share a kiss.
58: Later, Ian enters his sleeping father's mind once again.
59: In his father's memory, a van pulls up outside the lab, and someone hands over a small vial while saying that Kominsky ordered the formula delivered tonight.
60: The next day, Ian uses an illusion on a bank teller to walk away with a massive sum of cash.
61: When the teller unfolds the note Ian handed over, it contains only a single word of apology: "Sorry."
62: Bursting out onto the street with envelopes of cash, the pair head straight back to their hotel room.
63: However, Vicente is nowhere to be found in the hotel.
64: That night in the hotel room, the Perceptor suddenly appears before Ian.
65: The Perceptor projects a vision directly into Ian's mind before vanishing into the night.
66: Inside the illusion left behind by the Perceptor is a terrified woman clutching a baby in her arms.
67: When Vicente realizes the real name he hid his entire life has been uncovered, Ian's fury erupts.
68: Vicente tries to bring up his old rules, only to have those very rules turned against him.
69: Desperate, Vicente makes his son one final offer.
70: Instead, Ian leaves his father behind and sets off for Warsaw with Esther.
71: Together, the two board a train and cross the border.
72: On the outskirts of Warsaw stands the abandoned laboratory where Ian was born.
73: Inside, Ian stops in his tracks in front of a tiled room.
74: Hidden behind the tiled wall is a secret chamber where documents from the Awareness project still remain.
75: Meanwhile, Adriana pays a visit to Vicente, who has returned to his boat to drink alone.
76: Before leaving, Adriana tells him to stop drinking and try being a real father for once in his life.
77: Back at the Warsaw lab, the Perceptor appears before Ian once again.
78: Pointing a gun at him, Ian conjures multiple duplicates of himself to surround the Perceptor.
79: The Perceptor reveals that he is actually Ian's biological father and proceeds to tell him the whole truth.
80: He explains how the Mule turned the tables on the snipers sent to eliminate him, striking back with his own powers.
81: The survivors of that purge went on to form the organization known as Awareness.
82: Just then, Agency operatives storm the abandoned laboratory.
83: While the Perceptor holds off the agents, Ian and Esther make a run for the roof.
84: Esther jumps first and Ian throws himself down the escape chute after her, only to be captured and dragged back to the Agency's facility.
85: Strapping a helmet onto Ian's head, the Agency attempts to extract the formula from his body.
86: However, the results show that the formula has become too diluted inside Ian's system to be synthesized.
87: In the midst of the procedure, childhood memories of his mother flash through Ian's mind.
88: Using his powers to take control of the machinery, Ian shakes the entire laboratory and seizes the chaos to make his escape.
89: After barely escaping, Ian goes with Esther to find his mother, discovering a bald woman sitting in a wheelchair.
90: Ian enters his mother's memories, only to find that the Perceptor has followed him inside.
91: Within those memories, his mother is always singing the exact same song to him.
92: At that very moment, Agency operatives burst into the building.
93: As Ian opens his eyes beside his mother and his pupils turn pitch black, the agents suddenly begin shooting at one another.
94: Ian begins puppeteering the agents' bodies completely at will.
95: He even forces Adriana's hand to raise her gun and point it straight at her own head.
96: Arriving on the scene, Vicente stares at a gun lying on the floor.
97: In that split second, a gunshot rings out and Vicente collapses to the ground.
98: Seizing the opportunity, the Perceptor grabs Esther and takes her hostage.
99: Looking into his dying father's memories, Ian finally witnesses the truth of what happened that fateful day.
100: Vicente hadn't stolen the baby at all; he had given up everything to protect the child at the mother's desperate request.
101: With the truth finally revealed, Vicente takes his last breath in his son's arms.
102: Devastated by the loss of his father, Ian tracks the Perceptor down to a crowded party where he is holding Esther hostage.
103: The Perceptor takes control of the people around them and forces them to attack Ian.
104: From party guests to waiters, everyone in the room becomes the Perceptor's puppet and lunges at Ian.
105: Though people keep swarming him no matter how many he knocks down, Ian holds his ground alone, swinging liquor bottles to fend them off.
106: The Perceptor even conjures the image of Ian's dead father while choking the life out of him.
107: Realizing that Esther was an illusion planted by the Perceptor from the very beginning, Ian pieces together all of his memories.
108: Finally, Ian pulls the trigger, and the Perceptor collapses to the floor.
109: When the dust settles and everything is over, Ian holds Esther tightly in his arms.
110: Afterward, as Ian stands before Vicente's grave, Adriana approaches him.
111: Choosing the middle ground that his father once walked, Ian sets off down that path together with Esther.
112: Adriana stands back and watches as the two of them walk away into the distance.
113: That was the Spanish Amazon Prime original film Awareness, directed by Daniel Benmayor and starring Carlos Scholz alongside Money Heist's Pedro Alonso.
114: If you were in Ian's shoes, would you side with the Agency or Awareness—let us know in the comments!
